pr.d: Gaston's Visit: Gaston catches a cold when his cave has a leaky roof, so Holly invites him to stay at the Little Castle until it is fixed. But soon Gaston is taking over!
Journey to the Centre of the Earth: Naughty Daisy and Poppy magic their teacher, Mrs Fotheringill to the centre of the Earth, so Granpapa Thistle leads Ben and Holly on a rescue mission.

It is raining, and Grandpa Rabbit has built a rocket pack. As he demonstrates it to Peppa and George, he inadvertently ends up atop a snowy mountain. Miss Hare attempts to rescue him but becomes stranded on the mountaintop as well.
Peppa is playing at Suzy's house, and they find out that Granny Sheep is moving in. She transforms the dull spare room and attic into an exotic boudoir and creative studio for her to make things.

Dr Hamster has brought a giant ant farm and opens the ant farm's lid to show how they got in. Nobody noticed they escaped and starting moving things in the classroom! The children place food around to lead the ants safely back.
Peppa and Rebecca Rabbit pretend to be babies to get Mummy Rabbit's attention. Mummy Rabbit plays along until they admit they are not really babies!

When the pups find kittens inside an old building, they think fast to bring the cats to safety before tearing the building down! / Motor's big drum performance in the symphony is almost ruined when the pups need to do loud demolition next door.
pr.sub: The Crew Demolishes A Soap Factory; The Crew Musically Demolishes A Building

pr.d: Roles are reversed when Priya has to save the Paw Patrol when animal hijinks occur at the farm.
Pups Save the Porcupine: When the Turbots accidentally bring a sleepy porcupine to Adventure Bay, the prickly critter gets loose and causes trouble everywhere it goes!
When the Ruff-Ruff Pack steals Mr. Porter's mini-donut maker, the Moto Pups set off to get the machine back in one piece; the Ruff-Ruff Pack takes over Humdinger's lair and runs off with his kitties.
pr.sub: Moto Pups: Pups Save the Donuts; Moto Pups: Pups Save the Kitties

pr.d: A darling delivery leads to a garden adventure, as Gabby and Pandy call on Kitty Fairy and crew to help grow an itty bitty blossom.
Miss Rabbit is teaching the children a swimming lesson, They start out by swimming with floats tucked under their arms.
The playgroup visits a nature reserve, specialising in tiny insects, bugs, and butterflies. So Pedro brings along his pet stick insect.
Peppa and George go sailing with Grandpa Pig, but when he keeps getting stuck in the mud, they all decide to have a sleepover on the boat while they wait for the tide to come back in.

Grandpa and Granny Pig show and share with Peppa and George their toys and hobbies. Granny shows her special doll from childhood and Grandpa his love of building toy planes. Peppa and George have great fun when Grandpa reveals his new biggest plane ever that even George can fit in.
Peppa and George check out Grandpa's new Bug Hotel as lots of insects arrive. A bumblebee cannot find a place in the hotel because the rooms are too small for him.
Peppa is intrigued to see her parents go to work every day. Daddy Pig makes Peppa her very own office to make her feel good.

After Peppa and family visit a tourist spot with her new friend Birgit Bear, the caravan unhooks from the car. The bear family stops it just in time, and they finish the day jumping muddy puddles at the caravan park.
Auntie, Uncle Pig, and cousin Chloe are coming for dinner and Peppa is allowed to join too! Peppa is very proud of staying up late; she even stayed up later than the Daddies!
A gang of squirrels appear at the Great Elf Tree. They are determined to store their acorns inside, but the Wise Old Elf has a cunning plan to stop them.
Nanny Plum is teaching the fairy girls some important fairy rules when she is blown away, trapped in a tree, dropped in a stream and covered in mud.
With Thomas in a rush to get a ton of hay bales delivered to the mainland by the end of the day, he tasks Terence the Tractor and Carly to assemble all the bales in his stead.
When the engines have the day off to play, Percy is kindly asked to referee their obstacle course race.
Grandad clears some caterpillars off his veg and safely puts them in a box for rehoming, but when Stan checks, all he finds is a strange object.
Stan keeps hearing the tune of an ice cream van, but it's not there! Seals are singing, whistles are blowing and birds are barking! What's going on?
When Tia misses the Spinny Star, Tim tries to recreate it for her.
Tim and Kai try to uncover trinkets buried at the beach.
Join Tim Rex, brother Tommy, sister Tia, and Triceratops bestie Kai as they tackle kid-shaped problems with dino-sized solutions! Tim, Tommy, Tia and Dad get stuck on a remote asteroid.
Paddington and his friends help PC Wells solve a mysterious case. Inspired by Aunt Lucy's special recipe, the Browns start a takeaway business from their home, but it proves to be hard work.
pr.sub: Paddington's Adventure Club Cracks The Case! / Paddington And Aunt Lucy's Special Recipe

pr.d: Madame Gazelle is making a wicker basket. She explains it is her hobby - something you do to relax. The children discuss hobbies and learn about each other's favourite things to do.
Mummy Pig and Peppa are at Granny Pig's house. They find Mummy's old patchwork quilt that Granny made for her as a baby. Peppa decides she'd like to make one for the baby!
Peppa is out with Suzy and Granny Sheep in Mummy Sheep's car. They come across an old van that Miss Rabbit is recycling. Granny Sheep decides she would like to turn it into an art van.
Peppa and her friends, accompanied by Mummy Sheep and Granny Sheep, take Vanessa to Grampy Rabbit's boatyard for inspiration. The children create various artworks using items found around the yard.
While Mummy and Daddy Pig attend a refresher antenatal class, Peppa and George join Miss Rabbit's Sibling School where they learn about what to expect when their new sibling arrives.
Peppa eagerly awaits her new sibling, growing impatient with the lengthy wait. Suddenly, Mummy Pig announces that the baby is coming right now.
The Pig family go to the hospital, where Peppa is determined to find the perfect name for the baby.
The nurse visits and decides to focus on teaching proper baby-holding techniques. She demonstrates a safe method for a small person, like Peppa, to hold an infant correctly.
George undergoes a medical examination to assess his hearing. The results of the test reveal moderate hearing loss in his left ear, marking an important milestone in his health and development.
Peppa is excited to help George explore the world of sounds now he has his hearing aid. She shows him her favourite sounds including the splashing of jumping in a muddy puddle!
Grandpa Pig and Grandad Dog are on their boats when Grandpa Pig drops an anchor on his foot! After an x-ray and plaster cast at the hospital, Grandpa Pig needs to stay overnight.
Grandpa Pig finds his night at the hospital so comfortable, he's reluctant to be discharged. Papa and Suzy volunteer to nurse him at home and make sure he's just as comfortable as he was in hospital.
A magical card arrives in the Little Kingdom, inviting everyone to a party at Granny and Granpapa Thistle's castle in the clouds.
Ben and Holly are having fun playing in the meadow. Holly gets frustrated when Ben uses his elf skills to win all the games, and Ben gets frustrated when Holly uses her magic skills.

Mummy Pig and Peppa are at the zoo and meet Lorenzo Lion who lives there; he is helping his daddy, Mr. Lion the zookeeper, take care of the zoo; Lorenzo shows Peppa his toy zoo, but he keeps misplacing his wooden animals in his two bedrooms!

At the gym, Madame Gazelle is teaching the children about martial arts. Along with Mr. Bull, the children learn how to fall safely, balance and even how to throw punches in the right stance. Mr. Bull gives them their white belts.
Grandpa Pig is taking Peppa and George for a day on his boat. They meet Mr Bull who is using his digger boat to remove all the rubbish in the river that shouldn't be there.
pr.sub: Mr Bull Digs Up the River

pr.d: Peppa and her family take Goldie the Fish to Doctor Hamster for her check-up. They see Grampy Rabbit and his pet newt. Doctor Hamster tells Grampy Rabbit about how she wishes she could exercise more but doesn't have any room. Grampy Rabbit decides to build something special to help Dr Hamster exercise more.
Peppa, George and Freddy Fox are mistaken for pirates while sailing on the river with Grandpa Pig. When the truth is revealed, officers Panda and Squirrel invite them for a ride in their police boat.
During a picnic in her garden, cousin Chloe shows Peppa and George fun things to do with flowers.
Auntie, Uncle Pig, and cousin Chloe are coming for dinner and Peppa is allowed to join too! Peppa is very proud of staying up late; she even stayed up later than the Daddies!
After finding out Daddy Pig has a place in the London Marathon, Peppa and George help Daddy Pig become stronger with lots of different, though not all typical, exercises.
Mummy Pig and Peppa are at Granny Pig's house. They find Mummy's old patchwork quilt that Granny made for her as a baby. Peppa decides she'd like to make one for the baby!
Peppa eagerly awaits her new sibling, growing impatient with the lengthy wait. Suddenly, Mummy Pig announces that the baby is coming right now.
Madame Gazelle needs to go to the dentist and Bull takes over Peppa's class. As the children already know the suggested themes, Bull decides to show them how to fix a floorboard that is creaking.
Peppa and George go behind the scenes to find out how TV is made when Miss Rabbit shows them around the set of Super Potato's TV show.
Mummy and Daddy Pig show Peppa and George how to play flying discs in the park. Soon their friends appear with their parents.
Peppa celebrates Goldie's birthday by holding an undersea party - by turning the house into an underwater environment.
Peppa finds a small bird on the ground in the garden of her house. She takes him to Dr Hamster, who explains that it is a swift and is probably tired after a long journey.

Mummy Pig, Daddy Pig, Peppa and George go to the skate park with their bicycles, scooters and skateboards. While Peppa has fun playing around on Daddy's skateboard, she soon learns that he is more of an expert than she realised.
Mr Labrador is here in his new ice cream van. It is his first day selling ice creams. In fact, Mr Labrador loves ice cream, perhaps a little too much.

Granny and Grandpa Pig have been growing strawberries to make jam, but the birds have eaten all the fruit. They decide to go and pick their own at Miss Rabbit's strawberry farm, but Granny and Grandpa eat too many strawberries and end up very full.
Peppa and her friends visit the Little Cars Play Centre where Miss Rabbit is in charge, and they get to drive little toy cars.
Mr Bull builds a brand-new clubhouse and slide for Peppa and her friends.
It's a snowy day and Peppa's family build an igloo for their snowman. They hide in it during a snowstorm, but Penny Polar Bear and her parents love snowstorms and also Peppa's igloo.
The children learn about the weather, there is a new friend for Peppa, and Peppa and George visit Granny and Grandpa's where Grandpa Pig is making a Rock Garden.
Mandy Mouse has a birthday visit to a cheese theme park with Peppa and her friends. Everything in the park is cheese-themed, and Mandy loves cheese.
Inspired by Granny Pig's stories of ancient Rome, Peppa and George decide to design the mosaic of a dinosaur with pebbles, and learn a little Latin.
Peppa and her family have gone on holiday, staying in a teeny tiny little holiday home near the beach. They discover that even when it rains, they can have lots of fun.
Peppa and all her friends are having a sleep-over, with different friends in each of the four different flats in the high street. They decide to play hide and seek across all the rooms.
Grandpa Pig and Grandad Dog are on their boats when Grandpa Pig drops an anchor on his foot! After an x-ray and plaster cast at the hospital, Grandpa Pig needs to stay overnight.
While drawing pictures at playgroup, Peppa and her friends learn about each other's families, from Suzy sheep who lives with Mummy Sheep to Freddy Fox who lives with Mr. Fox.

While Mummy Pig is at work, Peppa, George and Daddy make the best out of not being able to use the computer by tidying the kitchen, and when they find a jelly mould, they decide to make a nice surprise for their busy mum.
Grandpa and Granny Pig dust off their motorbike and sidecar to take Peppa and George on a trip. They go to the beach and camp in a tent that folds out of the sidecar.
Peppa Pig and Suzy Sheep are spending the day with Doctor Hamster, and they are learning about what vets do. Doctor Hamster says she's glad to have two helpers with her and calls the next patient.
While at a playgroup with Madame Gazelle, Peppa and her friends learn all about the weather by building themselves a Weather Station, complete with thermometer, wind turbine and rain collector.
Peppa's friend Pedro wears glasses, and Peppa thinks she might need them too, so Mummy Pig takes her to the optician.
Tiddles gets stuck in a tree and needs to be rescued. When the turtle falls on Pedro's nose, he needs to go to the doctors to make sure everything is OK.
Daddy Pig reads Peppa and George a bedtime story to help them fall asleep. When George wakes up again, Peppa has to make up a bedtime story to get him back to sleep.

Mummy Pig shows Peppa and her friend Suzy Sheep some old photographs from when they were babies. Peppa and Suzy don't remember being that young, but they are pleased to see that they have always been best friends.
It's bedtime, but Peppa is not sleepy, so Daddy Pig tells Peppa and George a story about a pretty princess and a dinosaur.
Daddy Pig has a book from the library that he has kept for too long. The family go to the library to return it and find more books to read.
Peppa and George go sailing with Grandpa Pig, but when he keeps getting stuck in the mud, they all decide to have a sleepover on the boat while they wait for the tide to come back in.
When Daddy Pig needs a new watch, Mr Fox finds three grandfather clocks in the back of his van. Three clocks are much better than one. Mr Fox has everything in his van, even a chicken.
Peppa and George want to be famous detectives like their favourite television programme 'Detective Potato', so Daddy Pig gives them a mystery to solve.

It's Richard Rabbit's birthday party and George is invited. That can only mean one thing, soft play. George and friends have great fun, swinging, bouncing and climbing, but it isn't quite as much fun for the grown-ups.
Peppa and George meet Kylie Kangaroo and her brother Joey. Peppa shows Kylie how to jump up and down in muddy puddles, and they see who can jump the highest.
The playgroup is going on an outing to the museum. Everyone is on the bus ready to go, except Pedro Pony, so where is he?
Peppa and the Pig family attend a school fête. Peppa's favourite things at the fête are face painting, the balloons, and the bouncy castle.

Peppa, George and Daddy Pig are excited about Mummy Pig's birthday and have lots of fun preparing surprises for her. When Mummy Pig sees her beautiful cake and opens her present, she is absolutely delighted.
At Peppa's playgroup, Madame Gazelle wants everyone to show the class their special talent.

Peppa and George's toy basket is full, and their beds are covered in toys, so Mummy Pig decides it is time to order a new toy cupboard. The cupboard arrives in the post, but it needs to be assembled - and Mummy and Daddy Pig are not very good at DIY. Luckily help is at hand, as Mr Zebra the Postman loves assembling flat-pack furniture.
Mummy Pig suggests the family all make pizzas together, so everyone prepares and chooses the food to make their own individual pizzas.
Peppa and her family hire a canoe from Miss Rabbit. They imagine they are in a jungle and then unexpectedly bump into Mrs Crocodile. Later on, Mr Lion invites them to have a picnic.
There's a new friend for Peppa at her playgroup, Lotte Lama. She can speak a foreign language, and Peppa loves talking. Everyone loves talking.
Peppa is excited to help George explore the world of sounds now he has his hearing aid. She shows him her favourite sounds including the splashing of jumping in a muddy puddle!
Peppa, her friends, and their parents, learn woodworking from Mister Wolf. He asks Daddy Pig to make a hut out of twigs, but it isn't very strong, and Mister Wolf manages to blow it down.
Mummy and Daddy Pig get stuck behind Mrs Badger's tractor on the way to her farm, where Peppa and George learn about how useful tractors can be, even if they aren't very fast.
Grampy Rabbit teaches Danny Dog and Peppa why his lifeboat is so important when it comes to saving lives at sea and gives them tips on how to stay safe.
Pedro loves superheroes. He has a superhero party and Super Potato is one of the guests. Together, they play some party games and Super Potato gets to show everyone his superpowers.
At the playgroup, Madame Gazelle is reading the children a story, but a page is missing so she makes up an ending. During playtime, the children make up their own alternative endings.

Peppa and friends are at Penny Polar Bear's house for a movie night; before they can watch it, the children need to decide where to sit, which popcorn to eat and take a toilet break -- then they're finally ready.
Peppa and her friends are playing in their clubhouse, which has a fold-down counter at the front. The children pretend to run a little shop for the parents to buy things from.

Peppa and her friends come to school early to have breakfast together. They learn about how food gives you energy and talk about their favourite breakfast foods. They all end up having toast with fun toppings. Finally, they have a good stretch and dance to get ready for the day and all sing the breakfast song.
Police Officer Panda and Police Officer Squirrel visit Peppa's playgroup. They offer two lucky children the chance to spend the day with them.
Miss Rabbit is teaching the children a swimming lesson, They start out by swimming with floats tucked under their arms.
Features the grown-up's singing competition where the kids are the judges.
It's the day of the duck race! When Miss Rabbit gives the sign, everyone drops their ducks in the river at the first bridge - whose will make it to the second bridge first?
Granny Pig places a large order of plastic gnomes and a wishing well for the garden, Peppa and George love them but Grandpa Pig is not happy. He wishes they would all disappear.

Peppa and her family oversee the building of a large remodel to their home to accommodate the new baby, but things go awry when Daddy Pig's blueprints get swapped for George's plans for a robot house.

Peppa and her friends are at playgroup and today Madame Gazelle would like them all to play music. They think they are playing with normal instruments, but today the children must make their own instruments. Madame Gazelle gathers bits and bobs of old packaging and shows them how to make their own. At the end of the day, they put on a special concert for the parents.
George and Peppa spend the day playing golf with Grandpa Pig, but they are much more interested in the colourful mini-golf course next door.
On a day out with her family, Peppa is encouraged to find words to describe the different kinds of puddles they find.
Peppa and Rebecca Rabbit pretend to be babies to get Mummy Rabbit's attention. Mummy Rabbit plays along until they admit they are not really babies!

Dr Hamster has brought a giant ant farm and opens the ant farm's lid to show how they got in. Nobody noticed they escaped and starting moving things in the classroom! The children place food around to lead the ants safely back.
Peppa is playing at Suzy's house, and they find out that Granny Sheep is moving in. She transforms the dull spare room and attic into an exotic boudoir and creative studio for her to make things.

It is raining, and Grandpa Rabbit has built a rocket pack. As he demonstrates it to Peppa and George, he inadvertently ends up atop a snowy mountain. Miss Hare attempts to rescue him but becomes stranded on the mountaintop as well.

Peppa and her family are going for a drive. Suddenly their car breaks down, and it has to go to Granddad Dog's garage to be fixed. While their car is fixed, they borrow a shiny new, blue car from Granddad Dog.

Peppa and her family go on a day trip to visit the Windy Castle. Mummy Pig drives, while Daddy Pig reads the map. When they reach the destination, Peppa and George spot Granny and Grandpa Pig's house.
Peppa's family go to the museum's moon exhibition with George's friend, Edmond Elephant.
Miss Rabbit has hurt her ankle, so her sister and her friends offer to fill in for her at the ice cream stand, the supermarket, and everywhere else she works.
Pedro Pony pretends he is a proper cowboy, telling everyone stories in the camp he has set up in the garden.
It's Wendy Wolf's birthday, and she has invited Peppa and all her friends to her party. There are bubbles and balloons to play with, and Wendy even teaches them how to howl like a wolf.
Peppa and her family borrow Grandpa Pig's boat and head out for a day on the river. All is going well until the boat gets stuck in some long reeds. Daddy Pig to the rescue.
When Peppa's bike gets a flat tyre that needs mending, Daddy Pig suggests they ride imaginary bikes. Peppa and her friends have fun riding their imaginary bikes and jumping in pretend muddy puddles.
Mummy Pig, Daddy Pig, Peppa and George go to the supermarket, and George sits in the trolley while Peppa finds the things on Mummy's shopping list.

It's Peppa Pig's birthday so she awakens very early. First, Peppa gets a present from Mummy, Daddy and George, and then it's time for her party. Daddy Pig does some funny magic tricks and makes a birthday cake appear with four candles for Peppa to blow out.
Peppa's family gets caught in a very long traffic jam whilst on the way to have lunch with Granny and Grandpa Pig.
Peppa and the rest of the playgroup put on a big Christmas show for all the parents. While Danny Dog is dressed up as a Santa, the real Father Christmas pays them a visit.
Peppa and George wake up one morning to find that all the rain has made a flood, and their house is now a desert island.
pr.sub: The Biggest Muddy Puddle in the World

pr.d: Before bed, Peppa and George have a bath, brush their teeth and listen to Daddy Pig read them a story. Finally, they're asleep and Mummy Pig and Daddy Pig can relax.
Peppa and George go to Rebecca Rabbit's house where, instead of stairs and corridors, there are tunnels.
Peppa and her family are playing at the pond with their toy boats, but when Peppa and George's friends arrive, everyone has a boat to play with except Rebecca Rabbit.
Daddy Pig is looking forward to taking Peppa and George to visit a fishpond that he used to visit when he was a piglet. However, a few things have changed since then.
Daddy Pig is taking everyone for a drive in the country, but the car is very muddy and Mummy insists they wash it first.
Pedro gets a cough at playschool and the other children soon catch it. Doctor Brownbear is called and gives them horrible medicine, but who will look after him when he is ill?
Peppa and her friends are playing hide and seek, but it is Freddy Fox with his super-smelling nose who is the best at playing that game.

Peppa takes Goldie the Goldfish for a visit to the vets and is surprised when she finds that there's a new road to be built over the building! With the help of Mr. Bull and his brother they find that instead of demolishing the vets they can build a tunnel underneath it.
Peppa and her family share a picnic with Mr Zebra the Postman and Zoe Zebra, but when it's time to go home, Peppa leaves her teddy behind.
Peppa and George are visiting their big cousin Chloe and will get to meet Chloe's new baby brother Alexander for the first time.
It's a very cold winter's day, and Peppa and George head to the park to play, but all the puddles have frozen over, so the two must think of other ways to entertain themselves.
At the climbing centre, Grampy Rabbit teaches the children about mountain climbing. For the really high climbing wall, Grampy attaches safety ropes to the children so they don't fall.
A new synthesiser arrives for Daddy Pig, and his family collect sounds for it from around the house while he is out at work.
On a cold day, Daddy Pig suggests they build a den until Mummy Pig has finished work. After a hard day's work, the cushion den is a perfect place to watch TV together!
Peppa and her family are on a caravan adventure; the first stop is the biggest potato in the world; when it starts to get too foggy, they park up for a rest before another busy day.

Peppa and her friends are at the clubhouse. They are playing at serving takeaway food. The children assign themselves different roles, including a cook and a waiter. Once the imaginary food is ready, they have fun delivering it.
Peppa and George play with walkie-talkies at Granny and Grandpa Pig's house. Grandpa Pig teaches Peppa and George how to use codenames to talk using the gadgets.
Mummy Pig dresses as a firefighter to practise fighting fires at the fire station with the other mummies. The fire brigade demonstrates how to do so effectively using their motto, Ready, Steady, Go.
For World Book Day, the playgroup must dress up as a character from their favourite book. But Peppa can't decide which as she has so many favourites.

When a storm cancels Peppa and her family's outdoor adventure plans, they decide to bring the fun indoors. Using their imagination, they go sledding, climb a mountain and enjoy a campfire in the attic.
At Chloe's birthday party, the children and grownups struggle to finish the inflatable obstacle course to reach the prize.
Peppa and her friends, accompanied by Mummy Sheep and Granny Sheep, take Vanessa to Grampy Rabbit's boatyard for inspiration. The children create various artworks using items found around the yard.

Peppa and her friends head to the trampoline park where Miss Rabbit shows them how to bounce. As Mummy Pig, Daddy Pig and Mummy Sheep watch the children play, they decide they want to have a go at trampolining.
Peppa and George learn some wonderful magic words. Nice things happen when they say please and thank you.

While Peppa and her friends are at playgroup, Madame Gazelle tells them about a lucky hamper of goodies they are going to make and place in a charity raffle. The project is a huge success, as the children gather fruit from their homes.
Peppa and George visit Granny and Grandpa Pig's garden, where Granny's friends are playing folk music. After they perform for Grandpa Pig, he treats everyone to freshly made apple juice.
Peppa is playing with Freddy Fox at his home, in a flat above the shops. Peggy and Pandora Panda and Candy Cat live there too, and help show Peppa around.

At the playground, Pedro and Penny's glasses fall off; both think that their glasses are broken, as they cannot see very well; Madame Gazelle shows Pedro and Penny different types of objects with lenses.
Peppa looks after Madame Gazelle's guinea pigs Ginger and Brian while she goes on holiday, but they prove to be more trouble for Mummy and Daddy Pig than they think.
Peppa and her friends are in a playgroup and Mr Bull is building a wind turbine. Madame Gazelle explains everything to the children about wind energy.
Mummy Pig suggests the family all make pizzas together, so everyone prepares and chooses the food to make their own individual pizzas.
Peppa and her family hire a canoe from Miss Rabbit. They imagine they are in a jungle and then unexpectedly bump into Mrs Crocodile. Later on, Mr Lion invites them to have a picnic.
There's a new friend for Peppa at her playgroup, Lotte Lama. She can speak a foreign language, and Peppa loves talking. Everyone loves talking.
Peppa is excited to help George explore the world of sounds now he has his hearing aid. She shows him her favourite sounds including the splashing of jumping in a muddy puddle!
Peppa, her friends, and their parents, learn woodworking from Mister Wolf. He asks Daddy Pig to make a hut out of twigs, but it isn't very strong, and Mister Wolf manages to blow it down.
George enjoys seeing his reflection in the mirror so much that he and Peppa try to find other shiny things to see themselves in.
Peppa gets shiny new red shoes and never wants to take them off, until it's time to jump in muddy puddles.
Peppa and George enjoy helping Grandpa Pig plant seeds in his garden.
Granny Pig shows Peppa and George her poultry. Elsewhere, something has been eating Grandpa Pig's lettuces.
Grandpa Pig takes Peppa, George and Danny Dog to visit Grampy Rabbit's lighthouse.
Daddy teaches Peppa and George a fun game to play while they wait inside for the rain to stop.
Peppa and George visit Daddy Pig's office and meet his colleagues. Mr Rabbit works with numbers, while Mrs Cat seems to spend her time drawing shapes on a computer.
Peppa and her friends go on a camping trip with their teacher, Madame Gazelle. After pitching their tents and collecting sticks, they all sing a song around the campfire.
Wishing Well: Granny Pig places a large order of plastic gnomes and a wishing well for the garden, Peppa and George love them but Grandpa Pig is not happy. He wishes they would all disappear!
A new student, Gerald the giraffe, joins the playgroup where Peppa and her friends go. However, when he tries to fit in, he finds it difficult to play hide-and-seek because he is so tall.
Peppa's family are at Digger World, where they have fun building walls and knocking them over again, and even help Mr Bull when there's an obstacle in the road.
George finds a very friendly spider in the bathroom. Peppa is very frightened until she realises that the little spider doesn't want to hurt her. She names him Mister Skinny legs.
Delphine the donkey comes to stay. Peppa takes Delphine to playgroup, where they teach her the 'Bing Bong Song'.
Mummy Pig gives her old computer to Granny and Grandpa Pig. They use it for lots of important work, as well as Happy Mrs Chicken, but when it breaks they are not sure who will fix it.
Peppa and her friends go to help at Edmond Elephant's birthday party, but the little children are harder to look after than they'd thought.
Peppa and George go to the seaside with Granny and Grandpa Pig and realise not all beaches are sandy. This one has lots of rocks and little rock pools to explore.
The doctor teaches children what to do if there is ever an accident. A patient soon appears, and they put into practise the new techniques they have learned.
There's a spider in the house. Mummy Pig tells Daddy Pig to get rid of it. Mr Skinny-Legs is set free in the garden, where he can spin all the webs he likes.
Peppa's playgroup are really enjoying Grampy Rabbit's talk about space rockets, until suddenly he loses his voice. Doctor Brown Bear must get him speaking again.

Peppa goes to her first ballet lesson, and meets her friends Candy, Suzy, Rebecca, Danny and Pedro there. She decides to teach Mummy Pig and Daddy Pig to dance but finds out they have some moves of their own.
George is upset when he loses his favourite toy, Mr Dinosaur. Peppa becomes a detective to track it down.
The family have a special day planned for George's birthday. They visit the museum and see dinosaurs, before ending the day with cake.
Daddy Pig loses his title as Champion Puddle Jumper until everyone helps him train to win it back.
Madame Gazelle introduces a new pupil to the playgroup, Emily Elephant, and everyone wants to be her friend because she's very good at building blocks and can make a very loud noise with her trunk.
Peppa, George and Daddy are in the garden painting a picture of a cherry tree when the ducks turn up and run through the paint, and all over their masterpiece.
Mummy and Daddy Pig get stuck behind Mrs Badger's tractor on the way to her farm, where Peppa and George learn about how useful tractors can be, even if they aren't very fast.
Grampy Rabbit teaches Danny Dog and Peppa why his lifeboat is so important when it comes to saving lives at sea and gives them tips on how to stay safe.
Pedro loves superheroes. He has a superhero party and Super Potato is one of the guests. Together, they play some party games and Super Potato gets to show everyone his superpowers.
At the playgroup, Madame Gazelle is reading the children a story, but a page is missing so she makes up an ending. During playtime, the children make up their own alternative endings.

Peppa and friends are at Penny Polar Bear's house for a movie night; before they can watch it, the children need to decide where to sit, which popcorn to eat and take a toilet break -- then they're finally ready.
Peppa and her friends are playing in their clubhouse, which has a fold-down counter at the front. The children pretend to run a little shop for the parents to buy things from.

Peppa and her friends come to school early to have breakfast together. They learn about how food gives you energy and talk about their favourite breakfast foods. They all end up having toast with fun toppings. Finally, they have a good stretch and dance to get ready for the day and all sing the breakfast song.
Police Officer Panda and Police Officer Squirrel visit Peppa's playgroup. They offer two lucky children the chance to spend the day with them.
Miss Rabbit is teaching the children a swimming lesson, They start out by swimming with floats tucked under their arms.
Features the grown-up's singing competition where the kids are the judges.
It's the day of the duck race! When Miss Rabbit gives the sign, everyone drops their ducks in the river at the first bridge - whose will make it to the second bridge first?

Peppa and her family oversee the building of a large remodel to their home to accommodate the new baby, but things go awry when Daddy Pig's blueprints get swapped for George's plans for a robot house.

Peppa and her friends are at playgroup and today Madame Gazelle would like them all to play music. They think they are playing with normal instruments, but today the children must make their own instruments. Madame Gazelle gathers bits and bobs of old packaging and shows them how to make their own. At the end of the day, they put on a special concert for the parents.
George and Peppa spend the day playing golf with Grandpa Pig, but they are much more interested in the colourful mini-golf course next door.
On a day out with her family, Peppa is encouraged to find words to describe the different kinds of puddles they find.
Peppa and Rebecca Rabbit pretend to be babies to get Mummy Rabbit's attention. Mummy Rabbit plays along until they admit they are not really babies!

Dr Hamster has brought a giant ant farm and opens the ant farm's lid to show how they got in. Nobody noticed they escaped and starting moving things in the classroom! The children place food around to lead the ants safely back.
Peppa is playing at Suzy's house, and they find out that Granny Sheep is moving in. She transforms the dull spare room and attic into an exotic boudoir and creative studio for her to make things.

It is raining, and Grandpa Rabbit has built a rocket pack. As he demonstrates it to Peppa and George, he inadvertently ends up atop a snowy mountain. Miss Hare attempts to rescue him but becomes stranded on the mountaintop as well.
At the climbing centre, Grampy Rabbit teaches the children about mountain climbing. For the really high climbing wall, Grampy attaches safety ropes to the children so they don't fall.
A new synthesiser arrives for Daddy Pig, and his family collect sounds for it from around the house while he is out at work.
On a cold day, Daddy Pig suggests they build a den until Mummy Pig has finished work. After a hard day's work, the cushion den is a perfect place to watch TV together!
Peppa and her family are on a caravan adventure; the first stop is the biggest potato in the world; when it starts to get too foggy, they park up for a rest before another busy day.

Peppa and her friends are at the clubhouse. They are playing at serving takeaway food. The children assign themselves different roles, including a cook and a waiter. Once the imaginary food is ready, they have fun delivering it.

Mummy Sheep gets the news that she has got a new job far away, leaving Suzy and Peppa to wonder how they're going to carry on being best friends; Peppa gives Suzy some presents to remember her by, before a surprising change for Mummy Sheep changes everything.

Peppa and her friends are busy building a desert island in a sandpit. They are all very proud of it, with its forest, lake, houses and shops. It's going splendidly, until George and Richard's dinosaurs turn up.
Peppa and George discover frogs, worms and butterflies in Granny Pig and Grandpa Pig's garden, and they play with them. Then Peppa, George and Grandpa have fun jumping in muddy puddles.
Peppa teases George because he can't catch a ball properly. Mummy Pig suggests they play a game that will help George learn how to catch, called 'Piggy in the Middle'.
It is Danny Dog's birthday, and with the help of Grandad Dog and Grandpa Pig the children take part in a pirate treasure hunt.
Baby Alexander is too young to talk until Peppa teaches him his first word.
Peppa and George realise that they have shadows and no matter what they do, they can't escape from them.

Madame Gazelle and the playgroup are sharing their favourite nursery rhymes. From singing Little Bo Peep to marching along with The Grand Old Duke of York, everyone enjoys listening to each other's choice.
Peppa wins her first star for making a wonderful drawing of her house. Dad realises that he has never won a single star and is determined to solve the problem.
Mummy and Daddy Pig take Peppa and George to a castle to feast on medieval banquets, play King and Queen, and even meet a dragon. It is George's favourite day ever.

The Carnival has come to town, and it's a chance to see all sorts of exciting things! There is Mr. Bull's Jazz Band, Miss Rabbit as the Carnival Queen and even a very special appearance from Mr. Potato.
Peppa and George are at the playground with their friends. Peppa loves to play on the swings, but George is a bit afraid of heights and doesn't like to be pushed too high.
Daddy Pig and Mr Bull are digging up the playground, so Daddy Pig decides to teach the kids some simple science. The first experiment is to see how many children it takes to pick up Madame Gazelle.

It is Molly Mole's first day at school and she quickly makes best friends with Peppa and Rebecca Rabbit. Molly shows them how good she is at digging while taking them on a tour of her underground house.

Peppa, George, Mummy and Daddy Pig have gone to visit Madame Gazelle. The family soon realise that her house is being pushed over by the tall tree next to it. Mr. Bull arrives and with his help they all manage to save Madame Gazelle's House and tree.
Madame Gazelle shows Peppa and her school friends how to make a time capsule, with each of them putting one of their favourite things in the capsule and burying it in the school garden.
When Peppa and George go to the dentist for a check-up, Dr Elephant says their teeth are nice and white, but George's toy dinosaur is in need of a tooth clean.
Oh dear, Miss Rabbit's train has broken down and all her passengers need to get to work. So Grandpa Pig lends Miss Rabbit his little train, Gertrude.
pr.sub: Grandpa Pig's Train to the Rescue

pr.d: What's that strange creature hovering in the sky? It's George's dinosaur balloon, but little George is finding it difficult to keep hold of his big balloon. Can anyone stop it from flying off to the moon?
Peppa's older cousin Chloe comes to visit, and Peppa must play games by somebody else's rules for a change.
Some of Daddy Pig's important work papers have gone missing because Mummy Pig, Peppa and George have accidentally made them into paper aeroplanes.
Peppa and family are at the school fair where the top prize in the raffle is a hot-air balloon ride.
Grandpa Pig needs help when his boat sinks, so Granddad Dog gives them all a lift to Grampy Rabbit's Boatyard so that the boat can be fixed.
The children's favourite teacher, Madame Gazelle, is leaving Playgroup. They are very sad to be losing her, but decide to throw a leaving party to give her a good send-off.

Perla will mit ihren Freundinnen eine Pyjama-Party veranstalten und wirft ihren Vater aus dem Haus. Der zieht also zu SpongeBob. SpongeBob will, dass Gary beim Schnecken-Schönheitswettbewerb gewinnt und macht ihn dafür hübsch.

Lil intros Jack to a deserted theme park: Lake Island; when they're stranded, their new friendship quickly crumbles; Will tries to connect with Jack at the oddball store Mike A's; everything goes awry and they must fight.
pr.sub: The Secret of Lake Island; Father, Son, and Furniture Store

pr.d: Plankton learns self-defense from Sandy in 'Single-Celled Defense', then in 'Buff for Puff', Mr. Krabs steps out of his shell and into the gym after Larry shows him up at the beach. (S14, ep 1)

Mr. Krabs, SpongeBob, Patrick und Thaddäus werden von einer riesigen Welle erfasst. Alle werden in eine andere Ecke gespült. Mr. Krabs landet im Holländer-Dreieck, von dem man nicht so leicht fliehen kann. Er braucht die Hilfe der Freunde.

Lil and her BFFs Anusha and Debs fight to win the coveted trophy at Hank n Beans arcade; determined to learn the truth about Jack's secret morning life, Lily does the unthinkable and wakes up early; her sleuthing gets them both in big trouble.
Theodore gets roped into doing Alvin's job in 'Adventures in Babysitting', then in 'Alvin's Assistant', Kevin agrees to be Alvin's assistant but ends up running errands instead. (S4, ep 3)

SpongeBob hat Glück: Er findet eine wertvolle Perle, die er für viel Geld verkaufen kann. Jetzt sind alle hinter seinem Geld her. Thaddäus will beim Männergesangsverein mitmachen und muss gegen SpongeBob antreten.

pr.t: The Boss Baby: Back in Business
pr.d: Boss Baby throws a cupcake party to combat low company morale, then sends a manager to help Tim handle some family business.
Sam and Kit look for a mysterious bird in 'The Puzzle of the Plummeting Eggs', then 'The Missing Mole Rat Princess', the duo tracks down a royal mole rat who left her underground palace. (S1, ep 3)

SpongeBob und Patrick sollen als Wrestler für Mr. Krabs in den Ring steigen und gewinnen. SpongeBob will unbedingt eine wertvolle und seltene Meerjungfraumann-Sammelkarte ergattern. Leider hat Patrick diese zuerst bekommen.
Brittany's style icon proclaims Jeanette is a fashion trendsetter; Theodore thinks that he is a real superhero.
An adventurous journey to the park occurs in 'Mission Park', then in 'Mar-Spooky-Lami', Marcel gets a fright. (S1, ep 12)

SpongeBob will mehr über die Wikinger herausfinden, aber keiner kann ihm so richtig helfen. Also schreibt er einen Brief an den lieben Wikinger. Patrick und SpongeBob verlassen kurz die Bootsfahrschule, um zu einer Autogrammstunde zu gehen.
When Phoebe learns Max's band plans to dump him, she suspects that his superhero training is hurting his friendships and attempts to help repair things.

Mr. Krabs' Piratenopa will seinen Enkel besuchen kommen. Allerdings weiß er nicht, dass Mr. Krabs gar kein Pirat mehr ist. Also muss die Krosse Krabbe zum Piratenschiff umgebaut werden. Und: SpongeBob muss Thaddäus aufmuntern.
Kico the Kittycorn: Every time a rainbow appears, a Kittycorn family gets their special baby Kittycorn! So when Gabby unboxes a baby Kittycorn, all the Gabby Cats help her take care of it. (S3, ep 6)
While preoccupied with Z-Force training, Phoebe and Max discover that they have forgotten special family events.

SpongeBob möchte unbedingt, dass Thaddäus ihn besucht, der könnte sich allerdings kaum etwas Schlimmeres vorstellen. Mit einem Trick lockt SpongeBob ihn rüber. Und: SpongeBob ist gezwungen, runde Hosen zu kaufen, in denen ihn jedoch niemand erkennt.
pr.sub: Besuch von Thaddäus; Quadrathose oder nicht sein

pr.d: Monkey goes looking for a star for Papa Smurf in 'Reaching for the Stars', then in 'The Dream Team', Handy puts together an A-team to get his jet pack back from Gargamel's hovel. (S3, ep 8)
When a video of Henry and Ray transforming into Kid Danger and Captain Man gets out, Henry must go to great lengths to retrieve it and protect his secret identity.

SpongeBob und Patrick vertreten Meerjungfraumann und Blaubarsch-Bube, die beide krank sind. Und: Als Thaddäus Lehrer einer Musikschule wird, wollen SpongeBob und Patrick natürlich direkt seine Schüler sein.
Alvin suffers another implausible miscommunication in 'Party Animals', and then in 'Warren Seville', Theodore invents a new imaginary friend. (S5, ep 13)
Henry and Charlotte travel to an opposite universe where evil counterparts of Ray and Schwoz want to destroy Piper.

SpongeBob nimmt einen Wurm bei sich auf, der herrenlos ist. Aber Gary hat die lästige Rivalin bald vertrieben. Plankton und Karen streiten und er gibt ihr die Schuld an seinem Unglück. Er will beweisen, dass er auch ohne sie zurechtkommt.
Jade is a great dancer and must face Mr Best in a dance-off in person. Mica and Jade put on a play to win their school a prize, but forget a key prop so the Marsups step in to help.
pr.sub: Dance Off; The Show Must Go On

pr.d: Simon moves into a tree for some alone time in 'Back To Basics', then in 'Report Cards', Alvin worries about his bad report card and does everything to catch the mail before Dave sees it. (S3, ep 2)

Als SpongeBob und Patrick sich Nachrichten per Muscheln schicken, gerät Thaddäus ins Chaos. SpongeBob glaubt, eine neue Allergie zu entwickeln, nachdem er bereits seinen millionsten Krabbenburger auf der Arbeit zubereitet.

Als der Zirkus in die Stadt kommt und seine Kunden stiehlt, versucht Mr. Krabs, die Show zu sabotieren. / Sandy verbringt den Tag damit, die Probleme aller zu lösen, kehrt dann aber nach Hause zurück und hat plötzlich eigene Probleme.

Mr. Krabs' Mutter verliebt sich in Plankton. Das passt ihrem Sohn natürlich gar nicht. Und: SpongeBob und Patrick freuen sich, denn der neue Film mit Meerjungfraumann und Blaubarschbube kommt ins Kino. Aber es gibt eine große Enttäuschung.
pr.sub: Wo die Liebe hinfällt; Meerjungfraumann und Blaubarschbube: Der Film

pr.d: Brainy accidentally gives Gargamel the idea to clone himself to increase his odds of catching Smurfs.
The trio try to outdo the Rat Bros at being good in 'The Altruistic-Off', then in 'The Album', Scissors dates a pop star. (S2, ep 6)
Storm hears Gargamel talking about a talisman that would give him the power to capture the Smurfs' village; she decides to get hold of it first so that she can save the village!
pr.sub: Storm and the Lost Talisman -- Part 1

pr.d: Nachdem Patrick einen Schlag auf den Kopf bekommen hat, ist er plötzlich ein genialer Denker. SpongeBob gefällt der neue Patrick gar nicht. Sandy verschmilzt aus Versehen SpongeBob und Thaddäus zu einer Person. Wie kommen die beiden da wieder raus?
The Smurfs think that they've found the famous Tree of Knowledge.
Paper connects with his friends in 'Paper Takes the Phones', then in 'The Bedtime Story', Paper and Scissors tell Rock a bedtime story. (S2, ep 7)
Storm claims that she's scared of nothing, so Jokey tries to prove her wrong. Hefty's shadow comes to life and rebels because it wants to be free to do whatever it wants.
pr.sub: Scary Stories; The Smurf Who Lost His Shadow

pr.d: Mr. Krabs will sein Restaurant in ein extravagantes Hotel verwandeln, um mehr Geld zu verdienen. Also müssen SpongeBob und Thaddäus den Gästen ab jetzt alle Wünsche von den Augen ablesen. SpongeBob wird einfach kein Bootsfahrer.
pr.sub: Dem Hotelier ist nichts zu schwer; Mrs. Puff, Sie sind gefeuert

pr.d: After getting detention again, Alvin's convinced Dave will drive him to the desert and abandon him there; Alvin and Theodore play a seemingly innocent game, which leads to unexpected consequences.
Lily uses a holiday to avoid the dentist in 'Summer Chuseok', then in 'Putting Up with the Plovers', Will makes an annoying new friend. (S2, ep 9)

Sandy muss sich etwas einfallen lassen, um ihre Erfindungen besser zu machen, um Geld zu bekommen. Ein berühmtes Gespenst, der Fliegende Holländer, übernachtet bei SpongeBob und erschrickt ihn die ganze Nacht, bis es langweilig wird.

Alvin's attempts to earn money as an Internet influencer almost puts a local toy store out of business; the Chipmunks accidentally ruin Dave's new pavilion, and they allow Miss Miller to take the fall.
Second Wind: Knuckles the Dread's pirate crew rages against Dr. Deep and Dr. Done It. The Eggforcers triumph and take Dredd's shard, abandoning the captive Rusty Rose behind. (S1, ep 11)

Mr. Krabs möchte seiner Tochter den schönsten Geburtstag aller Zeiten bescheren. SpongeBob bekommt die Aufgabe, heimlich herauszufinden, was das perfekte Geschenk für sie wäre. Und: SpongeBob wird auf die Karate-Insel zu einem Turnier eingeladen.
pr.sub: Der Sechzehnte Geburtstag; Der König des Karate

pr.d: SpongeBob muss einen neuen Bratenheber finden. Mr. Krabs baut einen Wunschbrunnen. Dort sollen die Gäste der Krossen Krabbe Münzen hineinwerfen, um einen Wunsch erfüllt zu bekommen. SpongeBob soll die Münzen herausholen.
pr.sub: Alles, was glitzert; Wünsch dir was!

pr.t: The Boss Baby: Back in Business
pr.d: Ousted from the office and desperate for direction, an unemployed Boss Baby joins a mommy-daddy-and-me playgroup, and he isn't the only new member.

Alvin agrees not to speak for 24 hours in 'Spoiler-Itis', then in 'Something's Fishy', when Alvin and Simon think Theodore's pet goldfish has died, they try to replace it before he notices. (S3, ep 4)

SpongeBob und Patrick finden sich nach einem Absturz bei den tiefsten Hinterdeichlern wieder und versuchen, sich zu arrangieren. Obwohl es ihm wehtut, muss Thaddäus wegen eines ausbrechenden Vulkans, SpongeBob wieder um Hilfe bitten.

pr.t: The Boss Baby: Back in Business
pr.d: A long line at the museum's family bathroom sends baby love into the toilet; the field team tries to evict the potty squatter and get things moving.
Simon is too embarrassed to kiss his co-star in the school play in 'Kiss Conspiracy', then in 'House Guests', Alvin secretly decides to rent out their house for a Hawaiian home-swap. (S1, ep 20)

Dora reist durch den Regenwald, um ein Lied für ihren Vater zu schreiben und Papa-Dora-Tag zu feiern. Bald ist Churro-Fest, doch die Piratenschweinchen essen alle Churros. Dora spürt eine Schatztruhe goldener Churros auf, um die Feier zu retten.

Paper and Pencil inadvertently create a horde of Rock clones and decide to look after them together. Rock, Paper, and Scissors find a genie, but just as they're about to make their wish, his 1,000-year curse runs out, and he can no longer grant it.
pr.sub: Rock, Rock, Rock, Rock, Rock, Paper, Scissors; The Wish

pr.t: The Boss Baby: Back in Business
pr.d: Research & Developments: Turtleneck wants to crack the Stinkless Serum formula and makes it a competition, pitting babies against babies. The first one to the Serum will be the new CEO! (S1, ep 25)

Tim, Tommy und Tia finden ein verlorenes Spielzeug und versuchen, es zu seinem Besitzer zu bringen. Kai freut sich darauf, mit dem Nebulator zu fahren, aber Tim ist sich unsicher. Tim und Kai wollen den Weltall-Käfer fotografieren.
pr.sub: Die Mondkuh / Der Nebulator / Der Weltraumkäfer

pr.d: The Stars' neighbour Gladys is a local vigilante. Patrick, GrandPat and Cecil want Bunny to honour their accomplishments on the fridge.
pr.sub: Neighborhood Wash / A Fridge Too Far

pr.t: The Boss Baby: Back in Business
pr.d: Wrinkles & Stickles: After Turtleneck is captured by Frederic Estes, Boss Baby and Tim attempt to rescue her, leading them to the terrifying "fun house" at the town fair. (S1, ep 26)

Die Stromrechnung fällt viel zu hoch aus, sodass Hektor und Rosa ihre Reise streichen. Ronnie Anne denkt darüber nach, wie sie den Stromverbrauch senken kann. Ronnie Anne entdeckt ein verborgenes Zimmer, das sie für sich behalten möchte.
SpongeBob and Patrick discover a surprising link to their favourite Kelp bed Kid; chaos ensues as everyone in Bikini Bottom starts meeping.

Paper is frustrated when Scissors gets a car in 'Emotional Support Convertible', then in 'The Baseball', the trio's baseball lands in an air force base, and they must enlist to get it back. (S3, ep 2)

Carl beobachtet Ronnie Anne, wie sie einen Hund rettet. Jetzt möchte er das Gleiche machen. Ohne dass es irgendjemand mitbekommt, schaut sich Ronnie Anne klammheimlich und unbemerkt die absolute Lieblingsserie ihrer Familie an.

When an exchange student comes to visit, he tells a scary story that makes the chipmunks think Dave is in danger. Annie and Amber offer to plan Brittany's birthday party, pitting her against Jeanette and Eleanor in the process.
pr.sub: The Exchange Student; Crystal Ball Birthday

pr.d: Patrick overstays his welcome at the SquarePants home in 'Make Yourself Pat Home', then in 'Accidentally in Love', GrandPat attempts to injure himself for Nurse Helga's attention. (S5, ep 4)
No description available · EPGTalk.com
Special agent Indie helps the pals reunite a lost bee with her hive; Sam and Kit try to uncover who has been chewing down the forest trees.
pr.sub: The Hunt for the Hidden Hive; The Trouble of the Toppled Trees

pr.d: Squidward creates a comic book of his own in 'The Nerds', and then in 'The SquarePants Method,' an actor shadows SpongeBob. (S17, ep 1)
The twins and Marsupilamis' game of golf results in Hope and Punch being caught by Stan. The Twins have Callie for a sleepover and whilst sleepwalking she meets the Marsupilamis.
The family gets grounded in 'Prison Break', then in 'Canyon Valley Film Festival', Jack enters the town's film festival. (S2, ep 6)

Schere verkauft sein Konterfei blindlings an eine neue Firma, die Windeln für Babys verkauft. Stein versucht, Papier und Schere davon zu überzeugen, dass er bereit für ein Haustier ist, indem er sich um einen tödlichen Roboterhund kümmert.
Gabby and Pandy take a travel adventure using a train, plane, cruise ship, and hot air balloon, but they can't forget to take pictures for CatRat.
Prank U Next: Max seeks help dealing with a mystery prankster at school from his old principal, who was always the target of his pranks. But Max fails to stop the pranks, and quits! (S1, ep 13)

Schere versucht, als Hausmeister zu arbeiten, merkt jedoch, dass in dem Job mehr zu tun ist. Dafür braucht er mehr Geschick, als er zuerst erwartet hat. Doch Stein und Papier wollen Schere in der Jobsuche aushelfen.

SpongeBob begibt sich auf eine epische Reise, um seinen geliebten Pfannenwender vom legendären Meister Fettweg neu schmieden zu lassen. // SpongeBob baut draußen ein Schneckenhaus, in dem Gary spielen kann, während er bei der Arbeit ist.
Blossom brings Scaredy on a trip to the forest to conquer his fear. When Painter Smurf wants to throw away Baby Smurf's art, it causes a sensation in the village.
Captain Jerk: Captain Man attempts to boost his image by holding a contest where three winners get a tour of his secret lair. But Henry's friends are among the winners! (S1, ep 22)

Thaddäus will unbedingt in dem neuen Pool im Hinterhof von SpongeBob schwimmen. Doch er versucht dem zu widerstehen. / Nachdem Mr. Krabs die "Burger-Pampe" auf die Karte der Krossen Krabbe setzt, bekommt er Besuch von dem Eisbuden-Paten.
pr.sub: Thaddäus und der Pool / Der Eisbuden-Pate

pr.d: When Simon falls ill, Alvin takes his place on a camping trip only to discover it's actually an archaeological dig; the Chipmunks don't know what to do when they suspect Dave is lying about the various awards he's won.
The Bucket Trap: Henry and Charlotte want to tell Jasper that Henry is really Kid Danger. They decide to give Jasper a test secret to prove he's ready. (S1, ep 23)

In der Krossen Krabbe tauchen immer wieder anonyme Mitteilungen am Anschlagbrett auf, die unter den Angestellten für Unmut sorgen. Diese Nachrichten führen zu Verwirrung und Misstrauen unter den Mitarbeiter:innen. Die harmonische Arbeitsatmosphäre wird dadurch erheblich gestört.

When the boys get tired of taking orders from Dave, they decide to build a tree house in the backyard and move out. When an invention of Simon's accidentally gets knocked over it magnetizes Alvin and Simon making them inseparable.
Yay Day: Cat invents a holiday which is just an excuse to buy presents for everyone. When Cat snoops what other people have got her, she discovers an insulting present from Sam. (S1, ep 21)

Der Großvater von Mr. Krabs kommt zu Besuch, welcher ein Pirat ist. Er glaubt, auch Mr. Krabs sei Pirat. Doch der hat schon lange niemanden mehr beraubt. Dennoch will er seinen Großvater gerne in dem Glauben lassen, er sei Freibeuter.

Als Mama Lupe zu Besuch kommt, versucht Abuela, die Familie kulturell auf Vordermann zu bringen. Adelaide und Carl erleben auf Mr. Changs Route ein Abenteuer, wobei sie zusammenarbeiten müssen, um den Tag noch zu retten.
pr.sub: Weck den Mexikaner in dir! / Zugführer Carl

pr.d: Franz Roll mistakes Scissors for a dog and adopts him, making Rock jealous of their relationship. Paper dreads his annual family get-together because his family's more accomplished than he is, so he hatches a plan to skip it.
pr.sub: Scissors is a Good Boy; Paper's Family Get-Together

pr.d: Lay Lay is the best friend anyone could ever want - but she's only an inspirational app. When Sadie makes a wish, Lay Lay is magically brought to life. Now, these two best friends can do anything!

Carls neuer Hit beinhaltet die Song-Passage einer anderen Gruppe. Ohne ihre Zustimmung kann sein Song nicht im Radio spielen. Außerdem müssen Ronnie Anne und ihre Skater-Freunde beim Völkerball um den Platz in der Turnhalle kämpfen.
pr.sub: Die Tropen-Früchtchen / Kampf um die Turnhalle

pr.d: Rock, Paper, and Scissors try to maintain their tradition of seeing every Moonami film on opening day; the trio ends up before a spider judge and jury for attempting to squish a spider in their apartment.
Floral Support: Max uses Phoebe to help retrieve his chronicle of evil deeds from the school's confiscation closet, but goes too far in breaking her trust to pull off his plan. (S3, ep 9)

Lincoln glaubt stark daran, dass die Schulköchin sauer auf ihn und seine älteren Schwestern ist. Mr. Grouse zieht von den Louds weg, um Abstand zu gewinnen und versucht zwanghaft, ein wenig Ruhe und Frieden für sich zu finden.
pr.sub: Die Geister der Vergangenheit; Mr. Grouse zieht aus

pr.d: Min tries to avoid the usual Woori World chaos, but when the family splits up they all get lost in their own fiascos. Jack's mission to find the rare DVD sequel of his favourite movie leads him to the mysterious Collector.
pr.sub: The Real Woori World; The Collector

pr.d: Patch Me If You Can: Phoebe visits her boyfriend's shy brother, but the mild-mannered boy discovers his evil side when he gets his hands on one of Max's inventions. (S3, ep 10)

Grouse versucht alles, um Lance und seine Familie wieder aus Royal Woods zu vertreiben, nachdem sie nebenan eingezogen sind. // Nachdem Lynn eine Online-Sportshow veröffentlicht hat, lernt sie schnell, wie sich mehr Klicks und Fans generieren lassen.
pr.sub: Nachbarn zum Gruseln / Zur Schnecke gemacht

pr.d: Friends become foes when Captain Dread's crew questions Sonic's loyalties. Then, a battle on the high seas breaks out over possession of the Shard.
Dream Busters: A villain's "dream beam" traps Henry in a crazy dream state that only Charlotte can rescue him from. (S1, ep 20)

Lisa ist neu in Lincolns Klasse. Sie verwandelt sich von einer Intelligenzbestie in eine Dummbratze, um nicht anzuecken. Dad schafft sich endlich einen neuen Van an. Die Kinder sind hocherfreut. Doch die Freude währt nicht lange.
pr.sub: Die Verwandlung der Lisa Loud; Ohne Van und aber

pr.d: Sandy, entschlossen alle bestehenden Stadtrekorde zu knacken, rekrutiert SpongeBob als ihren Helfer. Mit Ehrgeiz und Teamgeist wollen sie sich an die Spitze aller Rekordlisten setzen und damit in die Annalen der Stadt eingehen.

After Brittany and the girls release a video that goes viral, Alvin, Simon, and Theodore try to top it. Simon falls ill and asks Alvin and Theodore not to go see a new movie without him, but Alvin just cannot resist.
Kid Grounded: When Henry is caught sneaking out at night, he is grounded, keeping him from his crime-fighting duties. Piper drives him crazy at home. Charlotte becomes sidekick. (S1, ep 21)

1. Geschichte: Patrick räumt als "Patrick-Man" in Bikini Bottom mit dem Verbrechen auf - ob die Leute wollen oder nicht. 2. Geschichte: Gary ist wie besessen von seinem roten Ball und SpongeBob kriegt ihn nicht davon los.
The Chipmunks decide to find Dave a new girlfriend. The Chipmunks accidentally ruin Dave's new song for a music festival.
pr.sub: Slippin Thru My Fingers; Driving Dave Crazy

pr.t: The Boss Baby: Back in Business
pr.d: Escape from Krinkle's: Boss Baby gets a chance to return, but must escape Marsha Krinkle's safe Bubbeezee playroom with help from the group, while Tim nearly misses Kabob Day at school. (S2, ep 7)
SpongeBob steht vor der Aufgabe, seine Milchshake-Lizenz zu erneuern und muss dafür zurück an die Milchshake-Akademie. Dort wird er vermutlich erneut seine Fähigkeiten unter Beweis stellen müssen.

pr.t: The Boss Baby: Back in Business
pr.d: Ousted from the office and desperate for direction, an unemployed Boss Baby joins a mommy-daddy-and-me playgroup, and he isn't the only new member.
Stein macht sich auf die Suche nach einem Artefakt. Papier und Schere unterstützen Stein.
pr.sub: Franz Roll und die verschwundenen Regenbogen-Hotpants von Atraxes mit dem Apfelhintern

pr.t: The Boss Baby: Back in Business
pr.d: A long line at the museum's family bathroom sends baby love into the toilet; the field team tries to evict the potty squatter and get things moving.
Paper and Pencil tell a kind of funny joke in 'Paper and Pencil Tell a Joke', then in 'Scissors' Orchestra', Scissors gets a famous girlfriend. (S2, ep 2)
Patrick lernt über die Kindheit von GrandPats und Urzeit-Patrick moderiert eine Sendung.

Pearl stars in a guest appearance in 'Pearl Wants to Be a Star', then in 'Super Sitters', Patrick and SpongeBob go back in time to watch Mermaid Man and Barnacle Boy when they were new. (S1, ep 12)

Squidward gets hooked on games in 'Skill Crane', and then in 'Good Neighbour', Squidward's perfect Sunday is ruined by SpongeBob and Patrick, the Good Neighbour Club.

Craig Mammalton learns what it's like to not be the best at something in 'Eye of the Hotdog', then in 'Patrick Takes the Cake', Patrick and a cake hide out in the wilderness. (S1, ep 24)

A friendly day at the beach turns into all-out war in 'Sand Castles In The Sand', and then in 'Shell Shocked', an accident-prone SpongeBob damages Gary's shell, and must find a replacement.
Patrick and SpongeBob time-travel back to Viking times in 'Visiting Vikings', then in 'It's Too Late... With Plankton' Squidina hires Plankton to entertain the Lawnies. (S4, ep 12)
Bunny's mother visits from the old country in 'Which Witch is Which?', and then in 'Get Off My Lawnie', Granny Tentacles gets her own spin-off show. (S1, ep 25)
Plankton tries to befriend Squidward to steal the Krabby Patty formula in 'Sweet and Sour Squidward', and then in 'The Googly Artiste', Patrick's painted rocks with googly eyes are an artistic hit.
Patrick invents a new board game in 'Patrick! The Game', and then in 'The Sewers of Bikini Bottom', after accidentally flushing Mr Krabs' safe, SpongeBob and Squidward enter the sewers to find it.
It's the annual foam-fisted all-camp karate battle in 'Hill Fu', then in 'Sun's Out, Fun's Out', It's the hottest day of summer, but there's only one AC in the whole camp. (S1, ep 15)

Mr Krabs throws an event to boost morale, but Plankton is hosting his own on the same day in 'Company Picnic', and then in 'Pull Up a Barrel', Mr Krabs regales SpongeBob with tales from his Navy days.

It's the annual foam-fisted all-camp karate battle in 'Hill Fu', then in 'Sun's Out, Fun's Out', It's the hottest day of summer, but there's only one AC in the whole camp.
SpongeBob decides to leave his industrialised life and live off the land with the jellyfish. Fed up with SpongeBob and Patrick, Squidward decides to sell his house.
A secret snack experiment has monstrous side effects in 'Midnight Snack Attack', then in 'Hot Pearl-tato', Mr. Krabs needs to find a babysitter for Pearl, but she proves too much to handle.
SpongeBob and Patrick build a small clubhouse in a tree, when Squidward wants to join their club, he literally doesn't fit in. SpongeBob finds a stray seahorse and adopts it.
Patrick and Squidina take care of Granny Tentacles' house in 'Two Pests in a Teapot', then in 'Partial Recall', the Dartfish family adopts Plankton after he forgets who he is.
SpongeBob has never had a holiday. To save his job, Mr. Krabs gives him the day off. SpongeBob finds an old powdered wig in the rubbish and wears it thinking it's cool.
Loose Patrick's uncontrollable drooling gets out of hand and mouth in 'The Drooling Fool', then in 'Patrick's Got A Zoo', A shape-shifting alien runs loose in the Star home.

Plankton has demolished the Chum Bucket and in its place, he has built a Roman coliseum. The Bikini Bottom Symphony is accepting submissions for their composition contest, and Squidward is determined to win.
SpongeBob celebrates the anniversary of his friendship with Squidward in 'Friendiversary', then in 'Mandatory Music', Squidward's lack of talent lands him in a court ordered music class.
Squidward cleans up the city of Bikini Bottom with help from SpongeBob. SpongeBob brings Gary a pet that terrorises him.

pr.d: Sandy gets a brand-new suit. SpongeBob's newest friend is a hungry parasite inside of him.
Krabs and Plankton can't escape each other in 'Making Waves', then in 'Captain Quasar: The Next Iteration', SpongeBob and Bubble Bass form dueling fan clubs.
Patrick's injury recovery causes trouble for the camp. Rea and Roh learn to support themselves.

SpongeBob house-sits for Sandy, and all is quiet until Patrick shows up. After losing their passes, SpongeBob and Squidward try to sneak backstage at the sold-out Kelpy G show.
pr.sub: House Sittin' for Sandy; Smoothe Jazz at Bikini Bottom

pr.d: Patrick ventures inside Cecil to learn how the body works in 'To Dad and Back', then in 'Survivoring', Cecil takes his kids camping, but Squidina wants the drama of reality TV.
Sandy tries to study SpongeBob and Patrick's behaviour, but her science experiment goes horribly awry. Mr. Krabs takes Plankton's advice, and finally marries the only thing he ever loved, money.
Patrick hosts a time-travelling food show in 'Time to Eat', then in 'Cleaning House', while Bunny's in Klopnod, the Star home becomes a mess.
SpongeBob doesn't need a licence to operate a self-driving car in 'Drive Happy', then in 'Old Man Patrick', Patrick thinks he's an old man, so SpongeBob reminds him how much fun being a kid can be.
Krabs's house while he's away in 'Knock Knock, Who's There?', then in 'Pat Hearts Squid', Squidward is forced to room with Patrick, and Patrick begins to take after him.
Patrick and Octo must survive together in the forest after Octo twists all of his ankles. The adults sneak off to play a board game, but one of the campers is not easily shaken off.
When The Krusty Krab runs out of mustard, Mr. Krabs sends the team to find some more in 'Mustard O' Mine', then in 'Shopping List ', SpongeBob and Sandy have to collect Krabby Patty ingredients.
The campers meet two backwoods narwhals named Narlene and Nobby, who treat them to a sweet surprise.
SpongeBob and Squidward try to sell Krabby patties from a food truck in the darkest depths of the ocean. Pearl and Narlene have a whales' day out in the big city.
The Star family is a superhero team; Cecil works as a security guard at Lady Upturn's art museum.
pr.sub: Super Stars; Now Museum, Now You Don't

pr.d: SpongeBob helps Squidward remember a nice time in 'Are You Happy Now?', and then in 'Planet of The Jellyfish', an evil Jellien overlord replaces everyone in Bikini Bottom with clones.
The Patricks battle for control of the TV; Upturn moves in with the Stars.
Squidward becomes friends with a new neighbour in 'New Fish In Town', and then in 'Love That Squid', Squidward gets ready to go out on a date, and SpongeBob assists him.
An accident causes Patrick and Karen to switch bodies; a mischievous camp prank goes terribly wrong.
SpongeBob's predecessor pays a visit to the Krusty Krab in 'The Original Fry Cook', and then in 'Night Light', tales of the boogeyman send SpongeBob into a panic.
It's standup comedy night at Kamp Koral, and the campers are ready to laugh until they scream. Patrick gets confused with a young Seasquatch while out in the woods.
SpongeBob, Sandy, and Patrick hike through the woods in search of a fabled nudist colony; SpongeBob helps Plankton at the Krusty Kanteen, leading to the development of a very familiar sandwich.
pr.sub: In Search of Camp Noodist; Kitchen Sponge

pr.d: SpongeBob experiences a bad luck streak when his lucky tie clip suddenly goes missing.
pr.sub: Bad Luck Bob; The Sandman Cometh

pr.d: Patrick learns what GrandPat's childhood was like; Cave Pat hosts a show with his cave family.
pr.sub: The Lil' Patscals; The Pre-Historic Patrick Star Show

pr.d: After getting rid of Ouchie, Pinkeye takes over the Star house; Patrick and Squidina must find safety during the dad joke apocalypse.
pr.sub: Get Ouch; Day of the Living Dad Jokes

pr.d: SpongeBob eats sea onion ice cream and his breath stinks. When people avoid him, Pat convinces him that it's because he's ugly. When Mr Krabs gives his daughter Pearl a job at the Krusty Krab, she starts to make some changes.
Patrick and Squidina report the news around Bikini Bottom; "The Patrick Show!" presents the epic conclusion to the first half of its first season.
Bunny tries to punish Patrick for chocolate-favoured crimes. The Lawnies vote for what Patrick does next in a 'Choose Your Own Adventure' special.
pr.sub: At Home, On the Lam; Pick Patrick's Path

pr.d: Mr Krabs sells the Krusty Krab to a conglomerate and explores the joys of retirement. Squidward tricks his neighbour into believing that SpongeBob has a laugh-related illness.
Krabs reignites his passion for clowning. Mo learns a new kind of fun and camaraderie.
pr.sub: Krabsy the Klown/Lords of the LARP

pr.d: Plankton discovers competition in Narlene's backwoods restaurant; Sandy spends a night at the Trawler cabin.
SpongeBob and Mr Krabs turn an old submarine into a mobile Krusty Krab. When Patrick and SpongeBob discover they have clashing views on cleanliness, their disagreement blows up into an epic battle.
pr.sub: 20,000 Patties Under the Sea; The Battle of Bikini Bottom

pr.d: Squidward gets stuck indoors with SpongeBob and Patrick during a storm. Plankton creates an underground restaurant that threatens to put the Krusty Krab out of business.
Patrick is mistaken for a corporate retreat leader. Patrick and Squidina hold auditions for a Patrick Show sidekick.
Bubble Bass reviews "The Patrick Show"; Bunny brings Patrick to prison for Bring Your Kid to Work Day.
pr.sub: Bubble Bass Reviews; Patrick's Prison Pals

pr.d: SpongeBob comes up with a solution when Patrick cannot afford a holiday. Mr Krabs and SpongeBob win a free cruise thanks to Plankton. He sneaks along to steal the secret Krabby Patty formula.
SpongeBob gets a pair of long pants, but they change his life in unexpected ways. When Larry the Lobster opens a new gym in Bikini Bottom, SpongeBob becomes his best customer.

Camp Master Krabs finally hires a camp nurse, but she needs to dedicate all her time and effort to keeping SpongeBob safe. When all the campers try to win the "Stinkiest Camp in the Forest" award, Squidward has to fend for his life to stay clean.
pr.sub: First and Last Aid; Night of the Living Stench

pr.d: "The Patrick Star Show" is countrified; the Kelpbed Kids travel to the future.
Patrick messes with the space-time continuum; while Cecil and Bunny celebrate their anniversary in outer space, Patrick and Squidina throw a house party.
pr.sub: The Patterfly Effect; A Space Affair to Remember

pr.d: Squidward joins a crew of sailors hunting down the great white jellyfish; Plankton finds a magic bean that takes him to a land of giants.
pr.sub: Dopey Dick; Plankton and the Beanstalk

pr.d: When customers bring pets into the Krusty Krab, Mr. Krabs soon realises pets are more profitable than owners; Plankton ruins another date with Karen, so she puts the Chum Bucket on lockdown until he proves his affection.

pr.d: Patrick and Squidina go undercover to investigate a corrupt novelty product factory. The Patrick Show presents the Roast of Patrick Star.
A classic villain returns to his former lair, only to find the Star family inhabiting it; "The Patrick Show" rebrands for a younger audience.
pr.sub: X Marks the Pot; Patrick's Alley

pr.d: The Stars party at the Chum Bucket; Patrick hosts his show after dark, exploring what Bikini Bottom is like at night.
pr.sub: The Fun Bucket; The Patrick Show After Dark

pr.d: When SpongeBob cleans up the Boating School's lighthouse, he meets a cute but uncomfortable companion; no one is safe from a case of contagious hiccups.

Mr Krabs hires Squidward to babysit Pearl for the night, but she just wants to sneak out to a cool teen party. After spilling a milkshake during a delivery, SpongeBob vows to return and clean the entire building.
When stray snails start appearing around Bikini Bottom, SpongeBob decides to care for them himself. Patrick enters a Krabby Patty eating competition to defend Bikini Bottom's honour.

Mr Krabs is forced to give out free Krabby Patties to win back customers after Plankton drives them away. When SpongeBob's pineapple starts to fall apart, he enlists all of his friends to help him remodel it.
Patrick's big sister, Samantha, arrives for a visit. Sandy and Plankton bond over a shared love for science.
SpongeBob discovers that his breakfast cereal has an offer for a free toy. SpongeBob develops a case of Ick, the nasty itchy sea fungus that grows over everything it comes in contact with.
